title: Theatre Speed & Compact Bonsai
changes: Added Normal, Slow and Extra slow playback controls to Kaishi Theatre.
Kept Theatre speech, camera cuts, character animation and progress timing synchronized at every playback speed.
Remembered the learner's chosen Theatre speed between performances.
Made the dashboard bonsai card itself open the bonsai-condition explanation.
Removed the need for the separate bonsai information icon.
Reduced the bonsai card's height and spacing, especially on phones, so the rest of the dashboard appears higher.
Retained the v11.8.34 Reading-from-Meaning correction review pause.
Bumped Kaishi Quest caches to v11.8.35 so existing users receive the updated scripts.
